mapper.select: SELECT FROM wf_lifecycle_delivery d WHERE d.status IN ('PENDING','RETRY') AND (d.next_attempt_at IS NULL OR d.next_attempt_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ORDER BY d.id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM wf_lifecycle_delivery d WHERE d.event_id = #{eventId} AND d.status IN ('PENDING','RETRY') AND (d.next_attempt_at IS NULL OR d.next_attempt_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ORDER BY d.id
mapper.update: UPDATE wf_lifecycle_delivery SET status = 'RETRY', attempt_count = 0, last_error = NULL, next_attempt_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND event_id = #{eventId} AND subscriber_key = #{subscriberKey} AND status = 'DEAD'

UPDATE wf_lifecycle_delivery SET status = 'DELIVERED', attempt_count = #{attempts}, delivered_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, next_attempt_at = NULL, last_error = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'DISPATCHING'
UPDATE wf_lifecycle_delivery SET status = 'DISPATCHING' WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('PENDING','RETRY') AND (next_attempt_at IS NULL OR next_attempt_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

UPDATE wf_lifecycle_delivery SET status = 'RETRY', next_attempt_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_error = COALESCE(last_error, 'Recovered stale dispatch claim') WHERE status = 'DISPATCHING' AND updated_at < #{before}
mapper.select: SELECT event_id, tenant_id, instance_id, event_type, business_module_code, business_module_name, business_type, business_key, business_title, business_round, project_ref, project_name, action_path, data_digest, operator_id, occurred_at FROM wf_lifecycle_event WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.update: UPDATE wf_lifecycle_delivery SET status = 'DEAD', attempt_count = #{attempts}, last_error = #{message}, next_attempt_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'DISPATCHING'
UPDATE wf_lifecycle_delivery SET status = 'PENDING', attempt_count = #{attempts}, last_error = #{message}, next_attempt_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'DISPATCHING'

UPDATE wf_lifecycle_delivery SET status = 'RETRY', attempt_count = #{attempts}, last_error = #{message}, next_attempt_at = DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INTERVAL #{backoffMinutes} MINUTE) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'DISPATCHING'
